evidence.text: Reason for referral: Evaluation of an irregular pulse noted during a routine visit.

Findings: Normal sinus rhythm at 74 bpm. Normal axis. PR interval 146 ms, QRS 81 ms, QTc
410 ms.
Impression: Normal sinus rhythm with voltage criteria for left ventricular hypertrophy.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
35%. Mild aortic valve sclerosis without stenosis. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Moderately reduced left ventricular systolic funtion.
